facts.text: Evan mentions that his family is his rock and he is looking forward to expanding their family to create more memories.

evidence.quote: My family means the world to me. They're my rock. I'm looking forward to expanding our family and creating even more beautiful memories.

facts.text: Evan plans to hold a big family reunion next summer as a way to add to their family memories.

evidence.quote: we're planning a big family reunion next summer. It's going to be a blast and a perfect opportunity to add to our collage.

facts.text: Evan references a family motto from their trip to Banff, which is displayed on a sign in a frame that reads 'Bring it on Home'.

evidence.quote: It's from our trip to Banff. We have this sign in the frame that says 'Bring it on Home' - it's our family's motto, always reminding us of the importance of togetherness, no matter where we are.

facts.text: Sam expresses support for Evan's family plans and offers assistance in organizing the family reunion.

evidence.quote: If you need any tips on organizing such a big event, just let me know. I'm always here to support and celebrate your family's milestones.
